claims.text: The Assembly reports that the election writ was returned to the King 'today' (9 December 2014). According to Interim Speaker Lord Tupou, nominations for PM would be called on 19 December and close on 23 December, with the special sitting likely on 24, 29 or 30 December. After the vote, the Interim Speaker reports to the King that MPs recommend the winning candidate as Prime Minister designate, who 'will then be appointed by the King'.
claims.uncertainty: Procedural and prospective. The headline's 24 December was not the date the sitting was held (29 December; see to_la_20141229_pohiva_elected).
